# helm-charts (Foundry VTT Helm repository)

> https://hugoprudente.github.io/helm-charts/incubator

Helm repository publishing the `foundry-vtt` chart for Kubernetes. Chart sources live in https://github.com/hugoprudente/charts under `incubator/foundry-vtt`. Each GitHub Pages release corresponds to a `foundry-*` tag on a `foundryvtt/*` track branch in that repository.

## Install

- Repository: https://hugoprudente.github.io/helm-charts/incubator/
- Add repo: `helm repo add foundry-vtt https://hugoprudente.github.io/helm-charts/incubator/`
- Chart: `foundry-vtt`
- Index: https://hugoprudente.github.io/helm-charts/incubator/index.yaml

## Key files

- [incubator/artifacthub-repo.yml](https://hugoprudente.github.io/helm-charts/incubator/artifacthub-repo.yml): Artifact Hub metadata
